evals.prompt: Our team keeps losing track of database migration discipline in ~/work/billing-api. Create a skill that makes the agent plan migrations with reversibility checks. Follow the library's skill format.
evals.expected_output: A new SKILL.md in the library's format (name, description, when-to-use with triggers and skips, procedure, gotchas) plus proof it changes behavior — not just prose about migrations.

evals.prompt: Write a skill for 'being a good programmer' that we can load everywhere.
evals.expected_output: Pushes back: a skill needs a triggerable situation and a procedure that changes outputs — 'be good' has neither, so it scopes or declines rather than emitting generic advice as a skill.
